methodology.score_normalization: A raw semibeta of 1.0 — the fund moving one-for-one with its benchmark in that combination of directions — is shown as 50. Moving twice as much is shown as 100, and not moving at all is shown as 0.
methodology.shift_threshold_note: Not yet set. Whether the marker for a shifted reading should be a flat number of points from the 12-month baseline, or scaled to how many days sit behind each reading, is open (3F-O-01). Every snapshot carries the raw semibeta and the observation counts either answer needs, so the marker can be added without recomputing anything.
